Keep session on window shrink
Keep CarPlay connected when a reverse or 360 camera window shrinks it

When the window shrinks inside its original size (for example a reverse or 360 camera view), scale the existing CarPlay picture instead of reconnecting at the new size. Rotation and bar changes still reconnect.
BYD
Hide stock call popups (experimental)
Dismiss the BYD call popup while connected CarPlay is on screen

While connected CarPlay is on screen, use the stock HiCar interface to dismiss call popups. No ADB required. A popup may briefly appear before closing. With "Disconnect iPhone Bluetooth during CarPlay" on, popups normally do not appear at all. Turn off to restore the stock call interface.
Vehicle data (DiLink 4)
Vehicle speed and gear for tunnel navigation
Read-only BYD vehicle data when the iPhone requests it. Requires authorized network ADB and Location reporting.
Electric battery and range for Apple Maps (experimental)
Report battery and electric range. For DM-i, fuel range is excluded. Requires authorized network ADB; iPhone support determines availability.
Vehicle supports GB/T DC charging
Enable only if your variant supports DC charging; otherwise only the AC inlet is reported.
Battery capacity (kWh, 0 = automatic)
Use your variant\'s capacity if automatic detection cannot read the remaining energy (0-200 kWh).

Disconnect iPhone Bluetooth calls during CarPlay (recommended)
Calls go through CarPlay; the stock phone shows no popup
Disconnect iPhone Bluetooth music during CarPlay
Music goes through CarPlay instead of Bluetooth

CarPlay asks the head unit to drop these Bluetooth links. If music over Wi-Fi stutters, raise the music buffer under Audio, or turn off the music option to keep music on Bluetooth (the iPhone then shows Bluetooth as its output). Both links are restored 15 s after CarPlay ends. Applies on the next connection.
Wi-Fi scan diagnostics
Reading…
Reads through ADB which apps and system services scan Wi-Fi, and writes it to the log. Frequent scans make Wi-Fi P2P stall. Export the logs afterwards.
Wrote %1$d lines to the log. Export the logs to send them.
Call audio channel
For calls on BYD head units try 6 (Bluetooth call channel) first, then 0 (call channel). The test tone plays through the chosen channel.
Test: send call info to the cluster
Testing (10 s)…
Sends a test caller name and timer to the instrument cluster for 10 seconds. This only tests the cluster display.

%1$s

Did the cluster show the call?
Lower AC fan during CarPlay calls
Temporarily lower the fan through BYD\'s public AC interface during CarPlay calls

Off by default. During CarPlay calls (WeChat included) the fan is lowered to the level below; it is only ever lowered, and nothing happens while the AC is off. When the call or session ends, or the app exits, the previous level or automatic mode is restored; if you change the fan during the call, your setting is kept. Needs ADB authorization (BYD group); does not depend on the car\'s own call fan reduction option.
Fan level during calls
Level %1$d
Only applies when the fan is above this level. Default: level 2. Takes effect from the next call.
Test fan reduction (10 seconds)

Diagnostic manual test: use while parked, with the AC on and the fan above the selected level. Authorized vehicle ADB is required. The fan is lowered to the selected level for 10 seconds, then the previous level or automatic mode is restored. Does not change the automatic setting.
Stop fan reduction test
Stopping test…
The test has finished and sent the restore. Check that the fan dropped during the test and is back now; the details show the levels read back from the car.
The fan was not changed: the AC is off, the fan is not above the selected level, or a stock phone call is active. See the details below.
Test cancelled before the fan was changed.
The test did not finish successfully, or the restore could not be confirmed. Check ADB authorization, the AC state and the details below.
End the current call or wait for the running test to finish.
Pause head-unit Wi-Fi search during CarPlay (recommended)
Reduces Wi-Fi scan interruptions; also stops installed Gaode navigation

Through authorized ADB, pauses automatic Wi-Fi search during wireless CarPlay. If Gaode Auto is installed, attempts to restrict its Wi-Fi scans and force-stops it once per connection, ending stock navigation. Search and the original permission are restored 15 s after disconnect, or immediately when this option is disabled or the app exits. Gaode is not relaunched. The head unit cannot automatically join saved Wi-Fi networks while search is paused. Needs ADB authorization (BYD group).
Song and lyrics on the cluster
CarPlay song in the instrument cluster\'s music card

Shows \"title — artist\" with play and pause; for lyrics, turn on car or Bluetooth lyrics in the music app (QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music…), which puts the current line in the title. Written through the authorized ADB link; the card shows as \"other\" music source.
